tasks.title: Create the TypeScript application foundation
tasks.details: Set up the React, Vite, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Drizzle, and pg-boss application structure with pinned dependencies and shared type checking.

tasks.title: Implement database migrations and storage interfaces
tasks.details: Create the specified PostgreSQL schema, indexes, constraints, and durable versus disposable storage interfaces.

tasks.title: Implement startup recovery-generation controls
tasks.details: Block workers and mail mutations unless deployment and database recovery state match. Implement recovery modes and generation checks before idempotency lookup.

tasks.title: Implement passkey owner authentication and recovery
tasks.details: Provide console bootstrap enrollment, WebAuthn passkeys, session revocation, recent verification, last-credential protection, and operator recovery.

tasks.title: Implement encrypted account and identity management
tasks.details: Store mailbox credentials with AES-256-GCM, manage account labels and colors, discover folders, map roles, and manage validated send identities. Implemented and committed in 72b92cc; this pass re-verified workspace type checks and the full test suite, including the PostgreSQL-backed suites via TEST_DATABASE_URL, and needed no code changes.

tasks.title: Implement verified IMAP and SMTP connection tests
tasks.details: Require validated TLS for IMAP and SMTP, test each protocol separately, discover IMAP capabilities, and never send credentials before encryption succeeds. Implemented and committed in 985bf63; this pass re-verified workspace type checks and the full test suite, including the PostgreSQL-backed suites via TEST_DATABASE_URL, and needed no code changes.

tasks.title: Build durable MIME ingestion and parsing
tasks.details: Store original bytes before processing, parse headers and bodies, sanitize HTML, index text, and persist verified attachment locators and hashes.

tasks.title: Build resumable IMAP backfill
tasks.details: Import header ranges newest first with transactional checkpoints, UIDVALIDITY checks, bounded batches, and background body jobs.

tasks.title: Build steady-state synchronization and reconciliation
tasks.details: Poll folders, capture arrival bounds, refresh flags, detect expunges, handle folder generation changes, and run nightly inventory reconciliation.

tasks.title: Implement logical-message merging and thread reconciliation
tasks.details: Deduplicate verified copies within an account and safely link parents using message identifiers while preserving ambiguous and pending cases.

tasks.title: Build the recovery-aware mail action service
tasks.details: Create immutable action records, per-target receipts, idempotency handling, remote-state checks, and restart reconciliation for all mail mutations.

tasks.title: Implement two-way flag and move actions
tasks.details: Support explicit read, unread, star, unstar, archive, move, and bulk targets with revision checks, conditional writes, conflicts, and unknown move outcomes.

tasks.title: Implement full-text search and query operators
tasks.details: Provide cross-account PostgreSQL search for headers and bodies, filters, ranking, highlights, saved-search query state, and a 500 ms p95 target at 100k messages.

tasks.title: Create shared interface components and design tokens
tasks.details: Set up shadcn and Radix components, semantic Tailwind tokens, light and dark themes, icons, focus states, and reduced-motion behavior.

tasks.title: Build responsive mail navigation and message list
tasks.details: Create desktop three-pane and mobile single-pane layouts with account views, unified inbox, rows, state markers, account indicators, and bounded rendering.

tasks.title: Build the safe message reader and attachment routes
tasks.details: Render sanitized mail, collapse quotes, block remote images by default, resolve safe inline images, and provide authenticated attachment downloads and cache regeneration.

tasks.title: Implement clean view and reply quote extraction
tasks.details: Integrate pinned Defuddle and DOMPurify with safe fallback paths, redacted diagnostics, snapshot fixtures, and no implicit remote extraction.

tasks.title: Implement the command palette and keyboard controls
tasks.details: Add discoverable commands, nested choices, platform labels, shortcut scope, focus restoration, and touch alternatives.

tasks.title: Implement draft editing and durable uploads
tasks.details: Create the Markdown editor, revision-aware autosave, attachment upload verification, identity selection, and immutable draft locking for queued sends.

tasks.title: Implement reply addressing and frozen reply headers
tasks.details: Derive reply and reply-all recipients safely, require account and identity choices when needed, remove duplicates and identities, and freeze References headers.

tasks.title: Implement immutable outbound snapshots and SMTP sending
tasks.details: Generate and store exact MIME bytes, validate queued requests, enforce one submission, preserve recipient-level SMTP results, and create local sent records after acceptance.

tasks.title: Implement sent-copy append and uncertain-send recovery
tasks.details: Append confirmed mail to Sent in a separate job, reconcile lost responses using durable evidence, preserve unknown outcomes, and prohibit automatic resends.

tasks.title: Implement PWA offline data and replay controls
tasks.details: Use Dexie for recent mail, drafts, uploads, and queued actions. Preserve target revisions and recovery generations. Show sync state and require review after a restore.

tasks.title: Implement settings and synchronization status
tasks.details: Provide settings for density, shortcuts, account folders, identities, classification, and a visible per-account synchronization and queue status.

tasks.title: Integrate Jev classification in shadow mode
tasks.details: Add a pinned-model adapter, minimized message input, decisions storage, deterministic precedence, circuit breaker, monthly cost cap, and visible non-routing suggestions.

tasks.title: Create classification evaluation and correction flows
tasks.details: Build the evaluation command and correction events for one message, a sender, or a deterministic rule. Enforce the zero-critical-false-negative routing gate.

tasks.title: Implement health checks, audit events, and metrics
tasks.details: Expose health state for the database, synchronization lag, queue age, classifier state, and recovery mode. Record required audit events and account metrics.

tasks.title: Create Coolify deployment and backup procedures
tasks.details: Package the API, worker, database, volumes, environment checks, proxy settings, off-box backup, hash verification, and documented restore commands.

tasks.title: Build the fake mailbox and SMTP test harness
tasks.details: Provide scripted IMAP and SMTP scenarios for protocol faults, UID changes, expunges, malicious mail, attachment cases, interrupted sends, and session expiry.

tasks.title: Add sync, storage, threading, and search acceptance tests
tasks.details: Verify backfill restarts, copies, generation changes, thread ambiguity, attachment regeneration, concurrent flags, and header and body search behavior.

tasks.title: Add authentication, transport, and recovery tests
tasks.details: Test encrypted transport failures, enrollment races, credential recovery, restore generation handling, held operations, and client replay rejection.

tasks.title: Add compose and send safety acceptance tests
tasks.details: Test reply recipients and headers, snapshot immutability, SMTP outcomes, partial acceptance, append recovery, sent import, duplicate prevention, and restore behavior.

tasks.title: Add interface accessibility and performance validation
tasks.details: Automate browser and visual checks for keyboard and screen-reader flows, mobile and zoom layouts, focus, reduced motion, offline states, and palette responsiveness.

tasks.title: Run the release validation gate
tasks.details: Require type checks, migrations, integration tests, browser workflows, action permissions, and applicable interface checks before each release.
